accepted.title: A 34-vertex maximal rigid diameter-5 subset of the eight-dimensional Hamming cube
accepted.scope: Explicit 34-point subset of signed Q_8 with diameter exactly 5, inclusion-maximal subject to diameter <= 5, and a diameter partner at every point; hence b'(8;5) >= 34 > 32, refuting Briggs-Feng-Wells Conjecture 1 (b'(n;r)=2^r for n>=r).
source_targets: Briggs-Feng-Wells, Facets in the Vietoris-Rips complexes of hypercubes, arXiv:2408.01288 v1/v2, Section 6 Conjecture 1
accepted.substantive_reason: Refutes the conjectured extremal size in the central domain (n=8, r=5); the source Hadamard/product/fixed-coordinate constructions cannot exceed 2^r, and known maximum-anticode results (Kleitman, Ahlswede-Katona via Bezrukov 1987), Helly-type bounds and linear anticode bounds do not yield a rigid inclusion-maximal set above 2^r.
